newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Beiya in soyoil project.
newsitem.headline: China's Beiya in soyoil project.

text.p: Beiya Industrial (Group) Co Ltd said on Thursday its 30 million yuan ($3.6 million) project would begin production of soybean oil for use in pharmaceutical products by the end of this month.
Beiya Industrial, based in Harbin in the northeastern province of Heilongjiang, plans to produce an annual 3,000 tonnes of soybean oil by the end of this month, a company official said by telephone.
The company, which has A shares listed in Shanghai for domestic investors, is also studying a 114 million yuan joint venture to produce soybean-based food additives.
The venture is expected to go into production in the city of Anda in Heilongjiang in 1998. The company's partner would be the Anda municipal government.
Beiya is also expecting profits of about 10 million yuan annually from its production of IC cards and related electronic components.
The company official said this project was expected to have output value of about 120 million yuan annually. He did not give further details.
